findings.title: Two different time limits for a satisfactory drill
findings.explanation: Section 6 says a drill is satisfactory only if the evacuation time is six minutes or less. Section 7 says the report records the drill as satisfactory at eight minutes or less. A drill that took seven minutes is unsatisfactory under section 6, which requires a repeat drill, but satisfactory under section 7. The reader cannot obey both.
quotes: A drill is satisfactory if the evacuation time is six minutes or less and the sum equalled the attendance record.
The report records the drill as satisfactory when the evacuation time is eight minutes or less and the sum equalled the attendance record.

findings.title: No role resets the alarm system
findings.explanation: The step requires the alarm system to be reset before anyone returns. It is in the passive voice and names no role. No other passage gives the reset to the Safety Manager, a Fire Warden or anyone else. The Safety Manager announces the end of the drill and the Fire Wardens send occupants back, so the reset may be skipped.
quotes: The alarm system is reset before any occupant returns to the building.
